items.reason: Inclusion admits both 'Patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma' and 'Patients with IDH-mutant Astrocytoma, CNS WHO-Grade 4'; IDH-mutant grade 4 astrocytoma is not glioblastoma under CNS5, so several glioma types are eligible with glioblastoma named.

note: Phase NA psychological intervention trial: fails S3 (phase_not_applicable) and S6 (no_pharmacological_candidate), so population coding is moot. cns5_terminology (priority 3) proposed 'unclear' with medium confidence: conditions say 'Astrocytoma, Grade IV' (historical wording) but the inclusion text separates glioblastoma from 'IDH-mutant Astrocytoma, CNS WHO-Grade 4' (CNS5-style), with no IDH-wildtype requirement or WHO 2021 citation; 'historical' is defensible.
